transcript: Last night I went to see Wetbrain at Playwrights Horizons. A new play about family addiction and also aliens. Set in Arizona, 3 adult siblings are trying to take care of their father, who's severely impaired as a result of his alcoholism. That's the basic premise, but this play is actually really complex, both thematically and stylistically. It's comedic, it's dramatic, it's sad, it's mysterious, and it's SCI fi. The incredibly ambitious and transformative set design does a great job of propelling us into different mental spaces as well as physical spaces. In some ways, it feels like its own character in the play. Wetbrain is still in pretty early previews, and I think the pacing could be tightened up a bit, but overall I thought this was a really interesting and layered play that I would love to see again in its final form. With that, another program for my collection.
